title: Leave Policy Summary
canonical:
# Leave Policy Summary

Table 1 lists the leave entitlements by contract type. Part-time staff receive leave pro rata to their hours.

Table 1: Leave entitlements by contract

| Contract | Annual leave | Sick leave | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Full-time | 12 days | 30 days | Carry over until March |
| Part-time | Pro rata | 30 days | Based on hours |
| Intern | 6 days | 10 days |  |

## Allowances

Monthly allowances are paid with the salary and adjusted every year accordingly to the consumer price index.

| Item | Amount | Frequency |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Lunch | 730,000 | monthly |
| Parking | 150,000 | monthly |
| Phone | 200,000 | monthly |
